capabilities: generate a fully cited research node from a thesis written in IDEA.md
surface research gaps by traversing a node's ancestry and suggesting thesis topics
insert bidirectional links between semantically similar nodes via a built-in vector database
maintain a deduplicated citation ledger in SOURCES.md keyed and sorted by h-index
visualize node lifecycle status (draft, researched, verified) as graph colours via CSS snippets
disambiguation: Not a replacement for actual research: generated nodes can contain hallucinated citations, so human verification via the verified status tag is part of the workflow.
extras: The README carries a disclaimer that generated nodes may contain hallucinated citations and outdated information, and requires a human-set verified tag before output is trusted. Sci-Hub paper fetching is described as in beta. Planned but not yet available: Zotero integration, LaTeX literature-review export, and automatic contradiction detection.
problem: Building a cited research map in Obsidian is manual: the agent fills gaps by generating researched nodes, finding missing connections, and maintaining a vault-wide citation ledger.

relations.evidence: Ollama can be used for both local inference and local embeddings without an API key
via CSS snippets or the Style Settings plugin
Unpaywall email for open-access paper discovery

requires.name: OpenAI, Mistral, Anthropic, Ollama Cloud or other cloud LLM/embedding provider
local Ollama for offline inference and embeddings

summary: AI deep-research agent that generates fully cited markdown research nodes from a thesis and keeps the knowledge graph semantically linked and cited.
